## Products & Inventory
- Curated Bourbon: Small batch, single barrel, cask strength, and allocated releases (Weller, Blanton's, Buffalo Trace, Four Roses, Elijah Craig, Woodford Reserve, Knob Creek, Maker's Mark, Blue Note).
- Whiskeys: Tennessee whiskey (Jack Daniel's), Canadian whisky (Crown Royal), Irish whiskey (Jameson), Blended scotch (Dewar's, Johnnie Walker), Rye whiskey (Bulleit Rye), cinnamon whisky (Fireball).
- Tequila & Mezcal: 100% blue agave tequilas in blanco, reposado, and añejo styles, plus artisanal mezcals.
- Craft Beer & Seltzers: Local Kansas City craft beers, seasonal IPAs, lagers, ciders, and ready-to-drink seltzers.
- Fine Wines: Red wines (Cabernet Sauvignon, Pinot Noir, Shiraz, red blends), white wines (Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Moscato), rosé, and sparkling wines (Apothic, Barefoot, Bota Box, Josh Cellars, Kendall-Jackson, Meiomi, Sutter Home, Yellow Tail).
- Vodka & Rum: Premium vodkas (Tito's, Grey Goose, Absolut, Smirnoff) and rums (Captain Morgan, Bacardi, Malibu, Kraken).
- Smoke Shop: Premium handmade cigars, tobacco products, and smoking accessories.
